ev.q: This is only the second published case of MDR B. fragilis in the United States.
Both isolates demonstrated high levels of resistance by epsilometer test (E-test)
Microbiologic testing for the blood isolate demonstrated susceptibility to minocycline, linezolid, and tigecycline.
This report summarizes the case and highlights the need for awareness of multidrug-resistant organisms
